title: Fix MeetingPresencesRepository getAllAsync sentinel 404 behavior
objective: Remove getByMeetingId(0) sentinel behavior from getAllAsync and replace it with a real list-all endpoint or explicit unimplemented Failure.
acceptance_criteria: If a real list-all endpoint exists, getAllAsync delegates to an explicit API client method for that endpoint
If no list-all endpoint exists, getAllAsync returns Failure with a clear use getByMeetingId message and a TODO(backend) comment
Existing getByMeetingId, createAsync, and delete methods keep their public behavior
The repository interface matches the implementation after H3 explicit repository changes
flutter analyze for meetingPresences repository/API reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated meeting presences repository/API contracts if a real list-all endpoint is implemented
